final: SELECT AVG(group_avg_pressratio), AVG(group_avg_size_per_min) FROM (SELECT s.zoneref, site.typesite, AVG(s.pressratio) AS group_avg_pressratio, AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) AS group_avg_size_per_min FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS site ON site.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, site.typesite)
